description: A documentation theme inspired by Anthropic's site: warm ivory page, near-black ink text, a clay/terracotta accent, an editorial serif for headings paired with a clean grotesque sans for body/UI. NOTE: the theme font slots (sans/serif/heading) cannot set a separate monospace font for code — code styling lives in the renderer, and custom webfonts (Styrene/Tiempos, JetBrains Mono, etc.) cannot load through token values (no url()/@import allowed), so only system/web-safe family stacks are used here.
name: Anthropic-style docs

fonts.heading: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
fonts.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

whenToUse: Apply to give the Platform manual an Anthropic-like editorial-but-technical feel: warm neutral surfaces, serif headings, readable width. Pick this over Platform documentation when you want the warmer palette and serif display type.
